test_scalar_graph_creation: test creating a scalar graph with a random weight and verify arc count and node count
test_linear_graph_creation: test creating a linear graph with M rows and N columns and verify node and arc counts
run_gtn_scalar_graph: run gtn scalar_graph to create a graph with a single weighted arc and epsilon label
